```python
import pygame
import sys
import math

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TILE_SIZE = 48

GRAVITY = 0.7
PLAYER_ACCEL = 0.8
PLAYER_FRICTION = 0.82
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 6
PLAYER_JUMP_FORCE = 14

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()
font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 24)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, low, high):
    return max(low, min(high, value))

def make_surface(size, color, border=None):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    surf.fill(color)
    if border:
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, border, surf.get_rect(), 2)
    return surf

# ----------------------------
# Level
# X = solid block
# C = coin
# E = enemy
# P = player spawn
# ----------------------------
LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "......................C.........................................",
    ".............XXX................................................",
    "...............................................C................",
    ".........................XXX....................................",
    "...........................................................E....",
    "...........C....................................................",
    ".....XXX........................................................",
    "...................................XXXX.........................",
    "...............................C................................",
    "....................E...........................................",
    "..........XXXX..................................................",
    "....................................................XXXX........",
    "....P...........................................................",
    "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
]

WORLD_WIDTH = len(LEVEL_MAP[0]) * TILE_SIZE
WORLD_HEIGHT = len(LEVEL_MAP) * TILE_SIZE

# ----------------------------
# Sprite groups
# ----------------------------
all_sprites = pygame.sprite.Group()
solid_tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
coins = pygame.sprite.Group()
enemies = pygame.sprite.Group()

# ----------------------------
# Camera
# ----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(0, 0, width, height)

    def apply(self, rect):
        return rect.move(-self.rect.x, -self.rect.y)

    def update(self, target):
        self.rect.centerx = target.rect.centerx
        self.rect.centery = target.rect.centery

        self.rect.x = clamp(self.rect.x, 0, WORLD_WIDTH - SCREEN_WIDTH)
        self.rect.y = clamp(self.rect.y, 0, WORLD_HEIGHT - SCREEN_HEIGHT)

camera = Camera(SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT)

# ----------------------------
# Game objects
# ----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__(all_sprites, solid_tiles)
        self.image = make_surface((TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE), (90, 70, 40), (50, 35, 20))
        # add some visual detail
        pygame.draw.line(self.image, (120, 95, 55), (0, 12), (TILE_SIZE, 12), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(self.image, (120, 95, 55), (0, 28), (TILE_SIZE, 28), 2)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

class Coin(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__(all_sprites, coins)
        self.frames = []
        for i in range(6):
            surf = pygame.Surface((24, 24), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            radius_x = 8 + int(4 * math.sin(i / 6 * math.pi))
            pygame.draw.ellipse(surf, (255, 220, 40), (12 - radius_x // 2, 4, radius_x, 16))
            pygame.draw.ellipse(surf, (255, 245, 140), (12 - radius_x // 2 + 2, 6, max(2, radius_x - 4), 12))
            self.frames.append(surf)
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0
        self.image = self.frames[0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(center=(x + TILE_SIZE // 2, y + TILE_SIZE // 2))

    def update(self):
        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= 8:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(self.frames)
            center = self.rect.center
            self.image = self.frames[self.frame_index]
            self.rect = self.image.get_rect(center=center)

class Enemy(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__(all_sprites, enemies)
        self.frames_left = [
            make_surface((34, 34), (180, 60, 60), (110, 20, 20)),
            make_surface((34, 34), (200, 80, 80), (110, 20, 20)),
        ]
        self.frames_right = [pygame.transform.flip(f, True, False) for f in self.frames_left]
        self.image = self.frames_left[0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x + 7, y + 14))
        self.vx = 2
        self.vy = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

    def animate(self):
        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= 12:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % 2
        if self.vx < 0:
            self.image = self.frames_left[self.frame_index]
        else:
            self.image = self.frames_right[self.frame_index]

    def move_and_collide(self):
        self.vy += GRAVITY
        if self.vy > 14:
            self.vy = 14

        self.rect.x += int(self.vx)
        collided = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solid_tiles, False)
        for tile in collided:
            if self.vx > 0:
                self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                self.vx *= -1
            elif self.vx < 0:
                self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.vx *= -1

        self.rect.y += int(self.vy)
        self.on_ground = False
        collided = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solid_tiles, False)
        for tile in collided:
            if self.vy > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                self.vy = 0
                self.on_ground = True
            elif self.vy < 0:
                self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.vy = 0

        # edge detection
        if self.on_ground:
            front_x = self.rect.midbottom[0] + (10 if self.vx > 0 else -10)
            front_y = self.rect.bottom + 2
            support_rect = pygame.Rect(front_x, front_y, 2, 2)
            has_ground = any(tile.rect.colliderect(support_rect) for tile in solid_tiles)
            if not has_ground:
                self.vx *= -1

    def update(self):
        self.move_and_collide()
        self.animate()

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__(all_sprites)
        self.animations = self.build_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.facing = "right"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0
        self.image = self.animations["idle_right"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x + 8, y - 8))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(self.rect.x, self.rect.y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.score = 0
        self.health = 3
        self.invuln_timer = 0

    def build_animations(self):
        animations = {}

        idle1 = make_surface((32, 44), (70, 160, 255), (20, 60, 130))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle1, (255, 230, 180), (8, 4, 16, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle1, (50, 90, 200), (7, 18, 18, 18))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle1, (30, 30, 30), (9, 36, 6, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle1, (30, 30, 30), (18, 36, 6, 8))

        idle2 = make_surface((32, 44), (70, 160, 255), (20, 60, 130))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle2, (255, 230, 180), (8, 5, 16, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle2, (50, 90, 200), (7, 19, 18, 18))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle2, (30, 30, 30), (9, 36, 6, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(idle2, (30, 30, 30), (18, 36, 6, 8))

        run1 = make_surface((32, 44), (70, 200, 120), (20, 80, 40))
        pygame.draw.rect(run1, (255, 230, 180), (8, 4, 16, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(run1, (40, 140, 70), (7, 18, 18, 18))
        pygame.draw.rect(run1, (30, 30, 30), (7, 36, 6, 8))
        pygame.draw.rect(run1, (30, 30, 30), (20, 34, 6, 10))

        run2 = make_surface((32, 44), (70, 200, 120), (20, 80, 40))
        pygame.draw.rect(run2, (255, 230, 180), (8, 4, 16, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(run2, (40, 140, 70), (7, 18, 18, 18))
        pygame.draw.rect(run2, (30, 30, 30), (10, 34, 6, 10))
        pygame.draw.rect(run2, (30, 30, 30), (18, 36, 6, 8))

        jump = make_surface((32, 44), (255, 170, 70), (120, 70, 20))
        pygame.draw.rect(jump, (255, 230, 180), (8, 4, 16, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(jump, (180, 110, 40), (7, 18, 18, 18))
        pygame.draw.rect(jump, (30, 30, 30), (8, 35, 6, 7))
        pygame.draw.rect(jump, (30, 30, 30), (18, 35, 6, 7))

        animations["idle_right"] = [idle1, idle2]
        animations["run_right"] = [run1, run2]
        animations["jump_right"] = [jump]

        animations["idle_left"] = [pygame.transform.flip(f, True, False) for f in animations["idle_right"]]
        animations["run_left"] = [pygame.transform.flip(f, True, False) for f in animations["run_right"]]
        animations["jump_left"] = [pygame.transform.flip(f, True, False) for f in animations["jump_right"]]

        return animations

    def handle_input(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x -= PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing = "left"
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x += PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing = "right"

        if not (keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a] or keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]):
            self.vel.x *= PLAYER_FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.15:
                self.vel.x = 0

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = -PLAYER_JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def horizontal_collisions(self):
        self.rect.x = int(self.pos.x)
        collided = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solid_tiles, False)
        for tile in collided:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

    def vertical_collisions(self):
        self.rect.y = int(self.pos.y)
        collided = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, solid_tiles, False)
        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in collided:
            if self.vel.y > 0:
                self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.on_ground = True
            elif self.vel.y < 0:
                self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def animate(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0.5:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        anim_key = f"{self.state}_{self.facing}"
        frames = self.animations[anim_key]

        speed = 6 if self.state == "run" else 18
        self.anim_timer += 1
        if self.anim_timer >= speed:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if len(frames) == 1:
            self.frame_index = 0

        center = self.rect.center
        self.image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if self.invuln_timer > 0 and (self.invuln_timer // 4) % 2 == 0:
            temp = self.image.copy()
            temp.fill((255, 255, 255, 120), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)
            self.image = temp

        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(center=center)

    def collect_coins(self):
        collected = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, coins, True)
        self.score += len(collected)

    def check_enemy_hits(self):
        if self.invuln_timer > 0:
            return

        hit_list = pygame.sprite.spritecollide(self, enemies, False)
        for enemy in hit_list:
            # stomp enemy
            if self.vel.y > 0 and self.rect.bottom - enemy.rect.top < 18:
                enemy.kill()
                self.vel.y = -10
                return
            else:
                self.health -= 1
                self.invuln_timer = 90
                if self.rect.centerx < enemy.rect.centerx:
                    self.vel.x = -8
                else:
                    self.vel.x = 8
                self.vel.y = -8
                return

    def update(self):
        if self.invuln_timer > 0:
            self.invuln_timer -= 1

        self.handle_input()

        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.y = clamp(self.vel.y, -30, 16)

        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.horizontal_collisions()

        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.vertical_collisions()

        self.collect_coins()
        self.check_enemy_hits()
        self.animate()

# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
player = None

for row_index, row in enumerate(LEVEL_MAP):
    for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
        x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
        y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

        if cell == "X":
            Tile(x, y)
        elif cell == "C":
            Coin(x, y)
        elif cell == "E":
            Enemy(x, y)
        elif cell == "P":
            player = Player(x, y)

if player is None:
    player = Player(100, 100)

# ----------------------------
# Drawing
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, cam_x, cam_y):
    surface.fill((135, 206, 235))

    # distant hills
    for i in range(8):
        hill_x = i * 240 - (cam_x * 0.25) % 240
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (120, 190, 120), (hill_x, 320, 260, 140))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (90, 170, 100), (hill_x + 80, 340, 240, 120))

    # clouds
    for i in range(6):
        cx = i * 220 - (cam_x * 0.15) % 1320
        cy = 60 + (i % 3) * 35
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (cx, cy, 70, 35))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (cx + 25, cy - 12, 60, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (255, 255, 255), (cx + 50, cy, 70, 35))

def draw_ui(surface, player):
    score_text = font.render(f"Coins: {player.score}", True, (20, 20, 20))
    health_text = font.render(f"Health: {player.health}", True, (20, 20, 20))
    controls_text = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right   Jump: Space", True, (20, 20, 20))

    surface.blit(score_text, (20, 15))
    surface.blit(health_text, (20, 45))
    surface.blit(controls_text, (20, 75))

def reset_player(player):
    player.pos = pygame.Vector2(100, 100)
    player.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
    player.rect.topleft = (100, 100)
    player.health = 3
    player.score = 0

# ----------------------------
# Game loop
# ----------------------------
running = True

while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                player.jump()
            if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                reset_player(player)

    # Update
    coins.update()
    enemies.update()
    player.update()

    if player.rect.top > WORLD_HEIGHT + 200:
        player.health -= 1
        player.pos = pygame.Vector2(100, 100)
        player.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        player.rect.topleft = (100, 100)

    if player.health <= 0:
        reset_player(player)

    camera.update(player)

    # Draw
    draw_background(screen, camera.rect.x, camera.rect.y)

    for sprite in all_sprites:
        screen.blit(sprite.image, camera.apply(sprite.rect))

    draw_ui(screen, player)

    pygame.display.flip()

pygame.quit()
sys.exit()
```

```python
def load_sheet(sheet, frame_width, frame_height):

    for y in range(0, sheet_rect.height, frame_height):
```

```python
            create_frame(48, 64, (220, 70, 70), (255, 220, 180), 0),
            create_frame(48, 64, (230, 80, 80), (255, 220, 180), 1),
        ]
        self.run_frames = [
            create_frame(48, 64, (70, 140, 240), (255, 220, 180), -4),
            create_frame(48, 64, (70, 140, 240), (255, 220, 180), 4),
            create_frame(48, 64, (90, 160, 255), (255, 220, 180), -2),
            create_frame(48, 64, (90, 160, 255), (255, 220, 180), 2),
        ]
        self.jump_frame = create_frame(48, 64, (255, 180, 60), (255, 220, 180), 0)

        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.15
        self.current_frame_index = 0

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED

            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:

                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement

        for platform in platforms:

                if self.vel_y > 0:

                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        moving = self.vel_x != 0

        if not self.on_ground:

        self.animation_timer += dt
        if moving and self.animation_timer >= self.animation_speed:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.current_frame_index = (self.current_frame_index + 1) % len(self.run_frames)
        elif not moving and self.animation_timer >= 0.4:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.current_frame_index = (self.current_frame_index + 1) % len(self.idle_frames)

            image = self.jump_frame
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            image = self.run_frames[self.current_frame_index % len(self.run_frames)]
        else:
            image = self.idle_frames[self.current_frame_index % len(self.idle_frames)]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)
        return image

        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))
```

```python
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 16

def create_animation_frames(size=(40, 60), base_color=(220, 60, 60), count=4):
    """
    Create simple placeholder animation frames.
    Each frame is a colored rectangle with slight visual variation.
    """
    frames = []
    w, h = size
    for i in range(count):
        surf = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        color_shift = i * 12
        body_color = (
            min(base_color[0] + color_shift, 255),
            min(base_color[1] + color_shift // 2, 255),
            min(base_color[2] + color_shift // 2, 255),
        )

        # Body
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 10, 24, 40), border_radius=8)

        # Head
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (20, 10), 10)

        # Legs animate slightly
        leg_offset = (i % 2) * 4
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (12, 48, 6, 10 + leg_offset))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (22, 48, 6, 14 - leg_offset))

        # Eyes
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (17, 8), 2)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (23, 8), 2)

        frames.append(surf)
    return frames


# ----------------------------
# Platform class
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 40, 20), draw_rect, 2, border_radius=6)


# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 60)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = {
            "idle": create_animation_frames((40, 60), (220, 60, 60), 2),
            "run": create_animation_frames((40, 60), (60, 180, 75), 4),
            "jump": create_animation_frames((40, 60), (70, 120, 220), 1),
            "fall": create_animation_frames((40, 60), (160, 80, 220), 1),
        }

        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.current_animation = "jump"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "fall"
        else:
            if self.vel.x != 0:
                self.current_animation = "run"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]

        if len(frames) > 1:
            self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed
            if self.animation_timer >= 1:
                self.animation_timer = 0
                self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)
        else:
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        frame = frames[self.frame_index]

            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

TILE_SIZE = 64
GRAVITY = 0.8
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_STRENGTH = -16
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 18
ANIMATION_SPEED = 0.15

# ----------------------------
# Level layout
# X = solid block
# P = player spawn
# ----------------------------
LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................XXX.........................................",
    "................................................................",
    "..............XXX...............................................",
    "................................................................",
    ".................................XXXX...........................",
    "................................................................",
    "..........XXX...................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....P...........................................................",
    "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
]

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def load_sprite_sheet(path, frame_width, frame_height, scale=1):
    """
    Load a sprite sheet and split it into frames.
    Assumes frames are laid out horizontally.
    """
    sheet = pygame.image.load(path).convert_alpha()
    sheet_width, sheet_height = sheet.get_size()
    frames = []

    for x in range(0, sheet_width, frame_width):
        frame = pygame.Surface((frame_width, frame_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        frame.blit(sheet, (0, 0), (x, 0, frame_width, frame_height))
        if scale != 1:
            frame = pygame.transform.scale(
                frame,
                (int(frame_width * scale), int(frame_height * scale))
            )
        frames.append(frame)

    return frames


def create_placeholder_animation(color, frame_count=4, width=32, height=48, scale=2):
    """
    Creates simple placeholder animation frames if no sprite sheet is available.
    """
    frames = []
    for i in range(frame_count):
        surf = pygame.Surface((width, height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, width, height), border_radius=8)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (width // 2, 10), 6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (0, 0, 0), (6 + i, height - 18, 8, 14))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (0, 0, 0), (width - 14 - i, height - 18, 8, 14))
        surf = pygame.transform.scale(surf, (width * scale, height * scale))
        frames.append(surf)
    return frames


# ----------------------------
# Classes
# ----------------------------
class Platform(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill((100, 180, 100))
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, (70, 140, 70), (0, 0, size, size), 4)
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))


class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()

        # Try loading sprite sheets; fallback to placeholders
        try:
            self.animations = {
                "idle": load_sprite_sheet("idle.png", 32, 48, scale=2),
                "run": load_sprite_sheet("run.png", 32, 48, scale=2),
                "jump": load_sprite_sheet("jump.png", 32, 48, scale=2),
            }
        except:
            self.animations = {
                "idle": create_placeholder_animation((70, 120, 255), frame_count=4),
                "run": create_placeholder_animation((255, 180, 60), frame_count=6),
                "jump": create_placeholder_animation((255, 80, 80), frame_count=2),
            }

        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.image = self.animations[self.state][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def handle_input(self):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        self.vel_x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel_y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += self.vel_y
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_state(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

    def animate(self):
        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.frame_index += ANIMATION_SPEED

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

        frame = frames[int(self.frame_index)]

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        old_midbottom = self.rect.midbottom
        self.image = frame
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(midbottom=old_midbottom)

    def update(self, platforms):
        self.handle_input()
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_state()
        self.animate()


class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target):
        self.offset.x = target.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Clamp camera to level bounds
        self.offset.x = max(0, min(self.offset.x, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = max(0, min(self.offset.y, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))


# ----------------------------
# Build level
# ----------------------------
def build_level():
    platforms = pygame.sprite.Group()
    player = None

    for row_index, row in enumerate(LEVEL_MAP):
        for col_index, cell in enumerate(row):
            x = col_index * TILE_SIZE
            y = row_index * TILE_SIZE

            if cell == "X":
                platforms.add(Platform(x, y, TILE_SIZE))
            elif cell == "P":
                player = Player(x, y)

    level_width = len(LEVEL_MAP[0]) * TILE_SIZE
    level_height = len(LEVEL_MAP) * TILE_SIZE
    return player, platforms, level_width, level_height


# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    player, platforms, level_width, level_height = build_level()
    camera = Camera(level_width, level_height)

    sky_color = (135, 206, 235)

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()

        player.update(platforms)
        camera.follow(player)

        # Draw
        screen.fill(sky_color)

        # Draw platforms
        for platform in platforms:
            screen.blit(platform.image, (platform.rect.x - camera.offset.x,
                                         platform.rect.y - camera.offset.y))

        # Draw player
        screen.blit(player.image, (player.rect.x - camera.offset.x,
                                   player.rect.y - camera.offset.y))

        # UI
        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Arrow Keys | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 0.6
MOVE_ACCEL = 0.8
MAX_MOVE_SPEED = 5
FRICTION = 0.75
JUMP_FORCE = -12

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (100, 200, 100)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (120, 120, 120)

# ----------------------------
# Pygame setup
# ----------------------------
pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer - Initial Implementation")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# ----------------------------
# Helper functions
# ----------------------------
def create_frame(color, size=(40, 60), eye_offset=0):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    surf.fill(color)

    # face / eyes for visual distinction
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (0, 0, 0), (8, 10, 6, 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (0, 0, 0), (size[0] - 14, 10 + eye_offset, 6, 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 255, 255), (10, size[1] - 15, size[0] - 20, 5))
    return surf

def generate_player_animations():
    animations = {
        "idle": [
            create_frame((255, 180, 50)),
            create_frame((245, 170, 40), eye_offset=1),
        ],
        "run": [
            create_frame((50, 180, 255)),
            create_frame((60, 190, 255), eye_offset=2),
            create_frame((40, 170, 245)),
            create_frame((60, 190, 255), eye_offset=1),
        ],
        "jump": [
            create_frame((255, 80, 120)),
        ],
    }
    return animations

# ----------------------------
# World objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (80, 80, 80), draw_rect, 2)

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 60)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.acc = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = generate_player_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = 0.12

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.acc.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.acc.x = -MOVE_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.acc.x = MOVE_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_FORCE
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self):
        self.acc.y = GRAVITY

        # horizontal movement
        self.vel.x += self.acc.x
        if self.acc.x == 0:
            self.vel.x *= FRICTION

        if self.vel.x > MAX_MOVE_SPEED:
            self.vel.x = MAX_MOVE_SPEED
        if self.vel.x < -MAX_MOVE_SPEED:
            self.vel.x = -MAX_MOVE_SPEED

        if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.1:
            self.vel.x = 0

        # vertical movement
        self.vel.y += self.acc.y

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal move
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical move
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 0.5:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += self.animation_speed

        if self.animation_timer >= 1:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation][self.frame_index]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)

        # optional debug rect
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), pygame.Rect(draw_pos[0], draw_pos[1], self.rect.width, self.rect.height), 1)

# ----------------------------
# Level setup
# ----------------------------
platforms = [
    Platform(-200, 500, 2000, 80),   # ground
    Platform(200, 420, 140, 20),
    Platform(420, 360, 140, 20),
    Platform(650, 300, 140, 20),
    Platform(900, 380, 180, 20),
    Platform(1200, 320, 200, 20),
    Platform(1500, 260, 160, 20),
]

player = Player(100, 300)

# ----------------------------
# Camera

camera_y = 0

def update_camera(player):
    global camera_x, camera_y
    camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
    camera_y = player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

    # Keep camera from going too high above the level if desired
    if camera_y < 0:
        camera_y = 0

# ----------------------------
# Main game loop
# ----------------------------
def main():
    global camera_x, camera_y

    while True:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(platforms, keys)
        update_camera(player)

        # Draw background
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Draw simple distant ground strip

        # Draw platforms
        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # Draw player
        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # UI text
        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TITLE = "2D Platformer - Initial Implementation"

GRAVITY = 0.5
PLAYER_ACCEL = 0.6
PLAYER_FRICTION = 0.82
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 6
PLAYER_JUMP_STRENGTH = -12

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 90)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (120, 80, 50)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.timer = 0
        self.index = 0

    def update(self, dt):
        self.timer += dt
        if self.timer >= self.frame_duration:
            self.timer = 0
            self.index = (self.index + 1) % len(self.frames)

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]

    def reset(self):
        self.timer = 0
        self.index = 0

        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = self.create_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"

    def create_animations(self):
        def make_frame(color, w=40, h=60, eye_offset=0):
            surf = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, w, h), border_radius=8)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (10 + eye_offset, 15, 6, 6))
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (24 + eye_offset, 15, 6, 6))
            return surf

        idle_frames = [
            make_frame((255, 220, 80)),
            make_frame((245, 210, 70), eye_offset=1),
        ]

        run_frames = [
            make_frame((255, 140, 80)),
            make_frame((255, 120, 60), eye_offset=1),
            make_frame((255, 100, 50)),
            make_frame((255, 120, 60), eye_offset=-1),
        ]

        jump_frames = [
            make_frame((120, 220, 255)),
        ]

        fall_frames = [
            make_frame((100, 180, 255)),
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 220),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 100),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 100),
            "fall": Animation(fall_frames, 100),
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x -= PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x += PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = True

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = PLAYER_JUMP_STRENGTH
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.x *= PLAYER_FRICTION

        if abs(self.vel.x) < 0.1:
            self.vel.x = 0

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        previous = self.current_animation

        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.current_animation = "jump"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "fall"
        else:
            if abs(self.vel.x) > 0.5:
                self.current_animation = "run"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "idle"

        if previous != self.current_animation:
            self.animations[self.current_animation].reset()

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        surface.blit(frame, self.rect.topleft)

# Game

class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()

        self.player = Player(100, 100)

        self.platforms = [
            Platform(0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 40, SCREEN_WIDTH, 40),
            Platform(180, 420, 160, 20),
            Platform(420, 340, 180, 20),
            Platform(680, 260, 140, 20),
            Platform(760, 460, 120, 20),
        ]

    def run(self):
        while True:
            dt = self.clock.tick(FPS)
            self.handle_events()

            keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
            self.player.update(dt, self.platforms, keys)

            self.draw()

    def handle_events(self):
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                pygame.quit()
                sys.exit()

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    self.player.jump()

    def draw(self):
        self.screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        for platform in self.platforms:
            platform.draw(self.screen)

        self.player.draw(self.screen)

        pygame.display.flip()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Game().run()
```

```python
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.timer = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.timer = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.timer += dt
        while self.timer >= self.frame_duration:
            self.timer -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]

    def resolve_horizontal_collisions(self, platforms):
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

    def apply_vertical(self, dt):
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

    def resolve_vertical_collisions(self, platforms):
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        move = self.handle_input(keys)

        self.apply_physics(dt)
        self.resolve_horizontal_collisions(platforms)

        self.apply_vertical(dt)
        self.resolve_vertical_collisions(platforms)

        if self.on_ground and move == 0:
            self.vel.x *= GROUND_FRICTION
            if abs(self.vel.x) < 5:
                self.vel.x = 0

        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_x = self.rect.x - camera_x - 6
        draw_y = self.rect.y - camera_y - 8
        surface.blit(frame, (draw_x, draw_y))

        # Debug hitbox
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y), 1)

# Camera

class Camera:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        target_x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        target_y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2
        self.x += (target_x - self.x) * 0.1
        self.y += (target_y - self.y) * 0.1

        self.x = max(0, self.x)
        self.y = max(0, self.y)

# Level

def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(-200, 480, 2200, 80),
        Platform(220, 390, 180, 24),
        Platform(470, 320, 180, 24),
        Platform(760, 250, 180, 24),
        Platform(1080, 360, 220, 24),
        Platform(1380, 300, 180, 24),
        Platform(1640, 220, 160, 24),
    ]
    return platforms


def draw_background(surface, camera_x, camera_y):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # simple parallax clouds
    for i in range(8):
        x = (i * 260) - (camera_x * 0.3) % 2200
        y = 70 + (i % 3) * 40
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (245, 245, 255), (x, y, 90, 36))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (245, 245, 255), (x + 25, y - 12, 70, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (245, 245, 255), (x + 50, y, 90, 36))

    # distant hills
    for i in range(6):
        x = (i * 380) - (camera_x * 0.5) % 2400
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 190, 120), (x, 360, 320, 160))

    # foreground grass strip
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, GROUND_COLOR, (0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 40, SCREEN_WIDTH, 40))


# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()
    camera = Camera()

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # prevent huge physics jumps on lag spikes

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, platforms, keys)
        camera.update(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

        debug_text = [
            f"pos=({player.rect.x}, {player.rect.y})",
            f"vel=({player.vel.x:.1f}, {player.vel.y:.1f})",
            f"grounded={player.on_ground}",
            f"anim={player.current_animation}",
        ]

        for i, line in enumerate(debug_text):
            text = font.render(line, True, (20, 20, 20))
            screen.blit(text, (12, 12 + i * 22))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
def clamp(value, low, high):
    return max(low, min(high, value))

# Camera
# -----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect, world_width, world_height):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = clamp(self.offset.x, 0, max(0, world_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = clamp(self.offset.y, 0, max(0, world_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    def apply_rect(self, rect):
        return rect.move(-self.offset.x, -self.offset.y)


# -----------------------------
# Animation
# -----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]

        self.image.fill(PLATFORM_COLOR)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, GROUND_COLOR, (0, size - 8, size, 8))
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

# Player

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = self._create_placeholder_animations()
        self.current_state = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_state]

        self.image = self.current_animation.get_frame()

    def _make_frame(self, body_color, leg_offset=0, airborne=False):
        surf = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        # body
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8, 8, 18, 22), border_radius=6)

        # head
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (17, 8), 8)

        # eyes
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (14, 7), 1)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (20, 7), 1)

        # legs
        if airborne:
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 120), (13, 30), (10, 40), 4)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 120), (21, 30), (24, 40), 4)
        else:
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 120), (13, 30), (13 + leg_offset, 42), 4)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 120), (21, 30), (21 - leg_offset, 42), 4)

        return surf

    def _create_placeholder_animations(self):
        idle_frames = [
            self._make_frame((220, 80, 80), 0),
            self._make_frame((230, 90, 90), 1),
        ]
        run_frames = [
            self._make_frame((80, 180, 255), -4),
            self._make_frame((90, 190, 255), 0),
            self._make_frame((80, 180, 255), 4),
            self._make_frame((90, 190, 255), 0),
        ]
        jump_frames = [
            self._make_frame((255, 200, 80), 0, airborne=True),
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.35, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            self.vel.x += move * PLAYER_ACCEL / FPS
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION / FPS
                if self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x += PLAYER_FRICTION / FPS
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0

            self.vel.y = PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def move_and_collide(self, tiles, dt):
        # Horizontal
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            next_state = "jump"
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            next_state = "run"
        else:
            next_state = "idle"

        if next_state != self.current_state:
            self.current_state = next_state
            self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_state]
            self.current_animation.reset()

        self.current_animation.update(dt)
        frame = self.current_animation.get_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        self.image = frame

    def update(self, dt, tiles, keys):

        self.apply_gravity(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(tiles, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)

        surface.blit(self.image, draw_rect.topleft)
```

```python
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (10 + offset, h - 12, 10, 8), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w - 20 - offset, h - 12, 10, 8), border_radius=3)
    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (w // 2 - 8, h // 2 - 4), 3)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (w // 2 + 8, h // 2 - 4), 3)

    run = [
        make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), offset=0),
        make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), offset=4),
        make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), offset=0),
        make_frame(size, (80, 220, 120), (40, 160, 80), offset=-4),
    ]
    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (100, 180, 255), (60, 120, 220), offset=0),
    ]
    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
    }

            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms, dt):
        # Horizontal
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            new_anim = "jump"
            speed = 0.1
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 1:
            new_anim = "run"
            speed = 0.12
        else:
            new_anim = "idle"
            speed = 0.4

        if new_anim != self.current_animation:
            self.current_animation = new_anim
            self.frame_index = 0
            self.frame_timer = 0.0

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.frame_timer += dt
        if self.frame_timer >= speed:
            self.frame_timer = 0.0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(platforms, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0, camera_y=0):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.frame_index]

        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(image, draw_pos)

        # Optional debug rectangle:
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), (*draw_pos, self.rect.w, self.rect.h), 1)


def load_level(level_map):
    platforms = []
    player_spawn = (100, 100)

    for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
        for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
            x = col_idx * TILE_SIZE
            y = row_idx * TILE_SIZE

            if cell == "#":
                platforms.append(Platform(x, y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE))
            elif cell == "P":
                player_spawn = (x, y)

    return platforms, player_spawn


def draw_background(surface):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax-style hills
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (120, 190, 110), (-100, 380, 400, 180))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (110, 180, 100), (180, 360, 420, 200))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (100, 170, 95), (520, 390, 420, 170))


def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    player = Player(*spawn)

    while running:

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        player.update(dt, platforms, keys)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = max(0, player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2)
        camera_y = 0
```

```python
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_frame()
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))


# -----------------------------
# Camera
# -----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        target_x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        target_y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Smooth follow
        self.x += (target_x - self.x) * 0.1
        self.y += (target_y - self.y) * 0.1

        # Prevent looking above world top too much
        if self.y < 0:
            self.y = 0


# -----------------------------
# World setup
# -----------------------------
platforms = [
    Platform(-200, 500, 1600, 60),   # ground
    Platform(200, 420, 140, 20),
    Platform(420, 350, 140, 20),
    Platform(620, 280, 140, 20),
    Platform(850, 380, 180, 20),
    Platform(1120, 320, 140, 20),
    Platform(1320, 250, 180, 20),
]

player = Player(100, 300)
camera = Camera()

font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)


# -----------------------------
# Main loop
# -----------------------------
running = True
while running:
    dt = clock.tick(FPS)  # milliseconds since last frame

    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                player.jump()

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player.update(dt, platforms, keys)
    camera.update(player.rect)

    # Draw background
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax clouds
    cloud_color = (255, 255, 255)
    for i in range(6):
        cx = (i * 260 - int(camera.x * 0.3)) % (SCREEN_WIDTH + 300) - 150
        cy = 60 + (i % 3) * 40
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud_color, (cx, cy, 90, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud_color, (cx + 25, cy - 15, 70, 45))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, cloud_color, (cx + 50, cy, 90, 40))

    # Draw platforms
    for platform in platforms:
        platform.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

    # Draw player
    player.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)

    # UI
    info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
    screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

    pygame.display.flip()

pygame.quit()
sys.exit()
```

```python
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (w - 22, h - 16, 8, 10 - leg_offset))

def generate_player_animations():

    idle = [
        make_frame(size, (220, 80, 80), (255, 220, 120), eye_offset=0, leg_offset=0),

        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (140, 110, 70), draw_rect.inflate(-8, -8), border_radius=6)

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.animations = generate_player_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0.0
        self.animation_speed = {
            "idle": 0.5,
            "run": 0.12,
            "jump": 0.2,
        }

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 48, 64)

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms, dt):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 1:

            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        self.image = frames[self.frame_index]

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(platforms, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0, camera_y=0):
        image = self.image
        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)
        surface.blit(image, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

# Level
# ----------------------------

    Platform(200, 420, 180, 20),
    Platform(450, 350, 180, 20),
    Platform(700, 280, 180, 20),
    Platform(980, 380, 140, 20),
]

player = Player(100, 300)

# ----------------------------
# Main loop
# ----------------------------
def main():
    camera_x = 0
    camera_y = 0
    running = True

    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        # Clamp dt to reduce physics instability on lag spikes
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, platforms, keys)

        # Simple camera follow
        camera_x = max(0, player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2)
        camera_y = 0

        # Draw
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Background decorations
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (255, 245, 180), (820, 100), 40)
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, GROUND_COLOR, (0, 500 - camera_y, SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 500))

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # UI text
        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
        text = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: W/Up/Space", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## How it works

### Physics
- `vel.y` increases each frame due to gravity.
- Horizontal and vertical movement are resolved separately.
- Collision resolution:
  - move on X axis, resolve overlaps
  - move on Y axis, resolve overlaps
- `on_ground` is set when landing on a platform.

### Animation
- The player has 3 animation states:
  - `idle`
  - `run`
  - `jump`
- Frames are generated procedurally with colored rectangles.
- The displayed frame changes based on a timer and current movement state.

```python
    return max(minimum, min(value, maximum))

    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    surf.fill(color)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, border, surf.get_rect(), 2)

    ]

        make_frame(size, (70, 210, 110)),
        make_frame(size, (60, 200, 100)),
        make_frame(size, (70, 210, 110)),
    ]

    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (100, 160, 255)),
    ]

    fall = [
        make_frame(size, (180, 120, 255)),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
        "fall": fall,
    }

        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 40, 40), draw_rect, 2)

class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.pos = Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = Vector2(0, 0)
        self.acc = Vector2(0, 0)

        self.width = 40
        self.height = 56
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(int(x), int(y), self.width, self.height)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = create_player_animations()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.frame_timer = 0.0

        self.animation_speeds = {
            "idle": 0.45,
            "run": 0.10,
            "jump": 0.15,
            "fall": 0.15,
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.acc.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.acc.x = -PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.acc.x = PLAYER_ACCEL
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt):
        # Gravity
        self.acc.y = GRAVITY

        # Horizontal friction if no input
        if self.acc.x == 0:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x += PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0

        # Integrate velocity
        self.vel.x += self.acc.x * dt
        self.vel.y += self.acc.y * dt

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

        # Integrate position
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = int(self.pos.x)

    def resolve_horizontal_collisions(self, platforms):
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

    def apply_vertical(self, dt):
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = int(self.pos.y)

    def resolve_vertical_collisions(self, platforms):
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_state(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.state = "jump"
            else:

        else:
            if abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
                self.state = "run"
            else:

        speed = self.animation_speeds[self.state]

        self.frame_timer += dt
        if self.frame_timer >= speed:
            self.frame_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics(dt)
        self.resolve_horizontal_collisions(platforms)

        self.apply_vertical(dt)
        self.resolve_vertical_collisions(platforms)

        self.update_state()
        self.update_animation(dt)
```
