```python
import pygame
from pygame.math import Vector2

# ----------------------------
# Configuration
# ----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60

GRAVITY = 1800
PLAYER_ACCEL = 2200
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 320
PLAYER_FRICTION = 1800
PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY = -700
AIR_CONTROL = 0.65

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 90)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (100, 100, 120)

# ----------------------------
# Utility
# ----------------------------
def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.finished or len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_current_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# ----------------------------
# Sprite generation
# ----------------------------
def make_player_frame(body_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0, airborne=False):
    surf = pygame.Surface((40, 56), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Head
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (20, 10), 8)

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (12, 18, 16, 18), border_radius=4)

    # Arms
    if airborne:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, body_color, (12, 24), (6, 18), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, body_color, (28, 24), (34, 18), 4)
    else:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, body_color, (12, 24), (8, 24 + arm_offset), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, body_color, (28, 24), (32, 24 - arm_offset), 4)

    # Legs
    if airborne:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 60), (18, 36), (14, 48), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 60), (22, 36), (26, 48), 4)
    else:
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 60), (18, 36), (16 - leg_offset, 50), 4)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, (40, 40, 60), (22, 36), (24 + leg_offset, 50), 4)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (17, 8), 1)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, (0, 0, 0), (23, 8), 1)

    return surf


def build_player_animations():
    idle_frames = [
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0),
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=1, arm_offset=1),
    ]

    run_frames = [
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=-4, arm_offset=-3),
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=-1, arm_offset=-1),
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=3, arm_offset=2),
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0),
    ]

    jump_frames = [
        make_player_frame((220, 60, 60), airborne=True),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.35, loop=True),
        "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
        "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.10, loop=False),
    }


# ----------------------------
# World objects
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 60, 80), draw_rect, 2, border_radius=6)


class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.position = Vector2(x, y)
        self.velocity = Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = 32
        self.height = 52
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, self.width, self.height)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = build_player_animations()
        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if name != self.current_animation_name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, dt, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        control = 1.0 if self.on_ground else AIR_CONTROL

        if move != 0:
            self.velocity.x += move * PLAYER_ACCEL * control * dt
            self.velocity.x = clamp(self.velocity.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.velocity.x > 0:
                self.velocity.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.velocity.x < 0:
                    self.velocity.x = 0
            elif self.velocity.x < 0:
                self.velocity.x += PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.velocity.x > 0:
                    self.velocity.x = 0

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.velocity.y = PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.velocity.y += GRAVITY * dt

    def move_and_collide(self, dt, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.position.x += self.velocity.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.position.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.velocity.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.velocity.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.position.x = self.rect.x
                self.velocity.x = 0

        # Vertical movement
        self.position.y += self.velocity.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.position.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.velocity.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.velocity.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.position.y = self.rect.y
                self.velocity.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.velocity.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.current_animation.update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(dt, keys)
        self.apply_gravity(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.current_animation.get_current_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_x = self.rect.x - camera_x - (frame.get_width() - self.rect.width) // 2
        draw_y = self.rect.y - camera_y - (frame.get_height() - self.rect.height)

        surface.blit(frame, (draw_x, draw_y))

        # Uncomment for collision box debugging:
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y), 1)


# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = [
        Platform(-400, 500, 2000, 80),   # ground
        Platform(250, 420, 140, 20),
        Platform(470, 350, 140, 20),
        Platform(700, 280, 160, 20),
        Platform(980, 360, 180, 20),
        Platform(1260, 300, 220, 20),
        Platform(1560, 240, 140, 20),
        Platform(1760, 420, 240, 20),
    ]
    return platforms


# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer - Initial Implementation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    platforms = create_level()
    player = Player(100, 300)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # avoid huge physics steps on lag spikes

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_w, pygame.K_UP):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, keys, platforms)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_y = player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Clamp camera vertically for a nicer view
        camera_y = min(camera_y, 120)

        # Background
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Draw simple distant hills
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (120, 190, 120), (150, 480), 180)
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (110, 180, 110), (450, 500), 220)
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (100, 170, 100), (780, 490), 200)

        # Draw platforms
        for platform in platforms:
            color = GROUND_COLOR if platform.rect.y >= 480 else PLATFORM_COLOR
            draw_rect = platform.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, color, draw_rect, border_radius=6)
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (60, 60, 80), draw_rect, 2, border_radius=6)

        # Draw player
        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # HUD
        info = f"Pos: ({int(player.position.x)}, {int(player.position.y)})  Vel: ({int(player.velocity.x)}, {int(player.velocity.y)})  Grounded: {player.on_ground}"
        text = font.render(info, True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (12, 12))

        controls = font.render("Move: A/D or Arrows   Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(controls, (12, 36))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

# How it works

## Physics
The player uses:
- `position` as floating-point coordinates
- `velocity` for movement speed
- `gravity` applied every frame
- separate horizontal and vertical collision checks

This is a common and stable starting point for platformers.

## Collision
Movement is resolved in two passes:
1. move on X axis, then fix overlaps
2. move on Y axis, then fix overlaps

This avoids many corner-collision issues.

## Animation
The player switches animation based on state:
- in air → `jump`
- moving on ground → `run`
- otherwise → `idle`

Frames are generated with simple drawing code so there are no external image dependencies.

```python
# Config
# ----------------------------

SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540

PLAYER_SPEED = 300

AIR_CONTROL = 0.65
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 1200

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (70, 70, 70)

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color=None, eye_color=(255, 255, 255)):
    """Create a simple placeholder sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # Body
    pygame.draw.rounded_rect(surf, body_color, (0, 0, w, h), 8)

    # Accent
    if accent_color:
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w * 0.15, h * 0.65, w * 0.7, h * 0.18), border_radius=4)

    # Eyes
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (int(w * 0.35), int(h * 0.32)), max(2, w // 14))
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, eye_color, (int(w * 0.65), int(h * 0.32)), max(2, w // 14))

    return surf


def build_player_animations():
    """Return a dict of animation name -> list of frames."""
    size = (42, 58)

    idle = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 100, 40)),
        make_frame(size, (250, 170, 55), (220, 100, 40)),
    ]

    run = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (220, 100, 40)),
        make_frame(size, (255, 160, 50), (200, 90, 35)),
        make_frame(size, (255, 190, 70), (220, 110, 45)),
        make_frame(size, (245, 165, 55), (210, 95, 38)),
    ]

    jump = [
        make_frame(size, (255, 210, 90), (230, 120, 50)),
    ]

    return {
        "idle": idle,
        "run": run,
        "jump": jump,
    }


# ----------------------------
# Platform
# ----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, screen):
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLATFORM_COLOR, self.rect, border_radius=6)


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.pos = Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = Vector2(0, 0)
        self.size = Vector2(42, 58)
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(int(x), int(y), int(self.size.x), int(self.size.y))

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = build_player_animations()
        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.anim_frame = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0.0

        self.anim_speeds = {
            "idle": 0.45,
            "run": 0.10,
            "jump": 0.20,
        }

    def handle_input(self, dt, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_a] or keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_d] or keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
            move += 1

        control = 1.0 if self.on_ground else AIR_CONTROL
        self.vel.x = move * PLAYER_SPEED * control

        if move > 0:
            self.facing_right = True
        elif move < 0:
            self.facing_right = False

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, dt, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = int(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = int(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        speed_abs = abs(self.vel.x)

        if not self.on_ground:
            anim = "jump"
        elif speed_abs > 10:
            anim = "run"
        else:
            anim = "idle"

        if anim != self.current_animation:
            self.current_animation = anim
            self.anim_frame = 0
            self.anim_timer = 0.0

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        if len(frames) > 1:
            self.anim_timer += dt
            if self.anim_timer >= self.anim_speeds[self.current_animation]:
                self.anim_timer = 0.0
                self.anim_frame = (self.anim_frame + 1) % len(frames)
        else:
            self.anim_frame = 0

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(dt, keys)
        self.apply_physics(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, screen):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation][self.anim_frame]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        screen.blit(frame, self.rect.topleft)

            Platform(360, 340, 170, 20),
            Platform(620, 270, 160, 20),
            Platform(760, 430, 120, 20),

        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (255, 255, 255), (600, 90, 140, 45))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (255, 255, 255), (660, 70, 120, 50))

        self.screen.blit(text, (20, 20))

    def run(self):
```

```python
GRAVITY = 0.7
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
JUMP_SPEED = -14
MAX_FALL_SPEED = 18

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
BROWN = (110, 80, 50)
GREEN = (70, 180, 90)
RED = (220, 70, 70)
YELLOW = (255, 220, 80)
BLUE = (80, 140, 255)

# -----------------------------
# Level layout
# X = solid tile
# -----------------------------
LEVEL_MAP = [
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "....................XXX.........................................",
    "................................................................",
    "..............XXX...............................................",
    "...........................................XXXX.................",
    ".........................XXX....................................",
    "................................................................",
    "...........XXXX.................................................",
    "....................................XXXX........................",
    "................................................................",
    ".....XXX........................................................",
    "................................................................",
    "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
]

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------
def make_player_frames():
    """Create simple placeholder animation frames."""
    frames_idle = []
    frames_run = []
    frames_jump = []

    # Idle frames
    for i in range(2):
        surf = pygame.Surface((34, 46), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLUE, (6, 8, 22, 30), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, YELLOW, (17, 8), 8)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (11 + i, 6, 2, 2))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, BLACK, (19 + i, 6, 2, 2))
        frames_idle.append(surf)

    # Run frames
    for i in range(4):
        surf = pygame.Surface((34, 46), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, RED if i % 2 == 0 else BLUE, (6, 8, 22, 30), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, YELLOW, (17, 8), 8)
        leg_y = 36
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (12, leg_y), (10 if i % 2 == 0 else 14, 45), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (22, leg_y), (24 if i % 2 == 0 else 20, 45), 3)
        frames_run.append(surf)

    # Jump frame
    surf = pygame.Surface((34, 46), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, GREEN, (6, 8, 22, 30), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.circle(surf, YELLOW, (17, 8), 8)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (12, 36), (8, 43), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surf, BLACK, (22, 36), (26, 43), 3)
    frames_jump.append(surf)

    return {
        "idle": frames_idle,
        "run": frames_run,
        "jump": frames_jump,
    }

# -----------------------------
# Tile / Level
# -----------------------------
class Tile(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y, size):
        super().__init__()
        self.image = pygame.Surface((size, size))
        self.image.fill(BROWN)
        pygame.draw.rect(self.image, GREEN, (0, 0, size, 10))
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

class Level:
    def __init__(self, level_map):
        self.tiles = pygame.sprite.Group()
        self.width = len(level_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE
        self.height = len(level_map) * TILE_SIZE

        for row_idx, row in enumerate(level_map):
            for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
                if cell == "X":
                    x = col_idx * TILE_SIZE
                    y = row_idx * TILE_SIZE
                    self.tiles.add(Tile(x, y, TILE_SIZE))

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        for tile in self.tiles:
            surface.blit(tile.image, (tile.rect.x - camera_x, tile.rect.y - camera_y))

# -----------------------------
# Player
# -----------------------------
class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        super().__init__()
        self.animations = make_player_frames()
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0

        self.image = self.animations["idle"][0]
        self.rect = self.image.get_rect(topleft=(x, y))

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_UP] or keys[pygame.K_w]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_SPEED
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel.y > MAX_FALL_SPEED:
            self.vel.y = MAX_FALL_SPEED

    def move_and_collide(self, tiles):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for tile in tiles:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel.x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.state]
        self.animation_timer += 1

        speed = 8 if self.state == "run" else 20
        if self.animation_timer >= speed:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        image = frames[self.frame_index % len(frames)]
        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)
        self.image = image

    def update(self, tiles, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(tiles)
        self.update_animation()

# -----------------------------
# Camera
# -----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.x = 0
        self.y = 0

    def update(self, target_rect):
        self.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.x = max(0, min(self.x, self.width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.y = max(0, min(self.y, self.height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

# -----------------------------
# Main game
# -----------------------------
def draw_background(screen, camera_x):
    screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Parallax hills
    for i in range(6):
        hill_x = i * 300 - (camera_x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (100, 190, 120), (hill_x, 320, 260, 180))

def draw_ui(screen, font, player):
    text = font.render(
        f"Pos: ({int(player.pos.x)}, {int(player.pos.y)})  VelY: {player.vel.y:.2f}",
        True,
        BLACK
    )
    screen.blit(text, (16, 16))

def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 22)

    level = Level(LEVEL_MAP)
    player = Player(120, 120)
    camera = Camera(level.width, level.height)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(level.tiles, keys)
        camera.update(player.rect)

        draw_background(screen, camera.x)
        level.draw(screen, camera.x, camera.y)
        screen.blit(player.image, (player.rect.x - camera.x, player.rect.y - camera.y))
        draw_ui(screen, font, player)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
def clamp(value, minimum, maximum):
    return max(minimum, min(value, maximum))


def make_frame(size, body_color, accent_color, offset_x=0):
    """Create a simple placeholder sprite frame."""
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    w, h = size

    # body
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (8 + offset_x, 8, w - 16, h - 16), border_radius=8)
    # face/accent
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, accent_color, (w // 2 - 6 + offset_x, 14, 12, 12), border_radius=4)
    # feet
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (12 + offset_x, h - 14, 10, 8), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 40), (w - 22 + offset_x, h - 14, 10, 8), border_radius=3)

    return surf


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.timer = 0
        self.index = 0

    def update(self, dt):
        self.timer += dt
        while self.timer >= self.frame_duration:
            self.timer -= self.frame_duration
            self.index = (self.index + 1) % len(self.frames)

    def reset(self):
        self.timer = 0
        self.index = 0

    def get_current_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]

        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect, border_radius=6)

        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.current_animation = "idle"

            make_frame(size, (255, 180, 60), (255, 240, 180), 0),

        ]

            make_frame(size, (255, 150, 90), (255, 240, 180), 2),
            make_frame(size, (255, 130, 70), (255, 240, 180), -1),
            make_frame(size, (255, 150, 90), (255, 240, 180), 1),
        ]

        jump_frames = [
            make_frame(size, (120, 200, 255), (255, 255, 255), 0)
        ]

        fall_frames = [
            make_frame(size, (100, 170, 240), (255, 255, 255), 0)
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 220),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 100),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 100),
            "fall": Animation(fall_frames, 100),
        }

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY
        self.vel.y = min(self.vel.y, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        previous = self.current_animation

        if not self.on_ground:
            if self.vel.y < 0:
                self.current_animation = "jump"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "fall"
        else:
            if abs(self.vel.x) > 0:
                self.current_animation = "run"
            else:
                self.current_animation = "idle"

        if previous != self.current_animation:
            self.animations[self.current_animation].reset()

        self.animations[self.current_animation].update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.animations[self.current_animation].get_current_frame()

        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y))

    platforms = []

    platforms.append(Platform(-400, 480, 2400, 80))

    platforms.append(Platform(380, 330, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(600, 270, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(850, 360, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1120, 300, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1420, 240, 180, 20))

    camera_y = 0

    while True:

            if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
```

```python
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self):
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        self.vel_y = clamp(self.vel_y, -100, MAX_FALL_SPEED)

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += int(self.vel_x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.sprite.set_state("jump")
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.sprite.set_state("run")
        else:
            self.sprite.set_state("idle")
        self.sprite.update()

    def update(self, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity()
        self.move_and_collide(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.sprite.get_current_frame()
        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)

# ----------------------------
# Level
# ----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = []

    # Ground
    platforms.append(Platform(-400, 500, 2400, 80, GROUND_COLOR))

    # Floating platforms
    platforms.append(Platform(200, 420, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(420, 350, 160, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(650, 280, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(900, 380, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1180, 320, 160, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1450, 260, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1700, 420, 220, 20))

    return platforms

# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("2D Platformer - Initial Implementation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()

    camera_x = 0
    camera_y = 0

    running = True
    while running:
        clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(keys, platforms)

        # Camera follows player
        camera_x = player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        camera_y = player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Optional vertical camera clamp
        camera_y = max(0, camera_y)

        # Draw
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        player.draw(screen, camera_x, camera_y)

        # UI text
        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)
        info = font.render("Move: A/D or Left/Right | Jump: Space/W/Up", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(info, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## Features in this implementation

### Physics
- Gravity accelerates the player downward.
- Jumping applies upward velocity.
- Falling speed is capped.
- Axis-separated collision resolution:
  - horizontal collisions handled first
  - vertical collisions handled second

### Animation
- `AnimatedSprite` manages:
  - animation states
  - frame timing
  - frame switching
  - horizontal flipping
- States:
  - `idle`
  - `run`
  - `jump`

### Camera
- Camera centers roughly on the player.
- World objects are drawn relative to camera position.

```python
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540

GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 80)

# Helpers
# ----------------------------
def load_image(path, size=None):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        img = pygame.image.load(path).convert_alpha()
        if size:
            img = pygame.transform.scale(img, size)
        return img
    return None


def make_fallback_surface(size, color, border=(0, 0, 0)):
    surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    surf.fill(color)
    pygame.draw.rect(surf, border, surf.get_rect(), 2)
    return surf


# ----------------------------
# Animation
# ----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, speed=0.1, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.speed = speed
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0

    def update(self, dt):
        if len(self.frames) <= 1:
            return

        self.time += dt
        if self.time >= self.speed:
            self.time = 0.0
            self.index += 1
            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0

# Platform

class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = self.rect.move(-camera_x, -camera_y)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 40, 40), draw_rect, 2)


# ----------------------------
# Player
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, PLAYER_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = self.load_animations()
        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

    def load_animations(self):
        size = (PLAYER_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)

        idle_frames = [
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_idle_1.png"), size),
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_idle_2.png"), size),
        ]
        run_frames = [
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_run_1.png"), size),
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_run_2.png"), size),
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_run_3.png"), size),
        ]
        jump_frames = [
            load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "player_jump.png"), size),
        ]

        # Fallbacks if images are missing
        idle_frames = [
            frame if frame else make_fallback_surface(size, (255, 220, 80))
            for frame in idle_frames
        ]
        run_frames = [
            frame if frame else make_fallback_surface(size, (255, 140, 80))
            for frame in run_frames
        ]
        jump_frames = [
            frame if frame else make_fallback_surface(size, (120, 220, 255))
            for frame in jump_frames
        ]

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, speed=0.45, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, speed=0.10, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, speed=1.0, loop=False),
        }

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation_name != name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel.x = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel.x = -PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel.x = PLAYER_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt

    def move_and_collide(self, platforms, dt):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)

        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)

        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.vel.y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.vel.y = 0
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y

    def update_animation(self, dt):

            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 1:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.current_animation.update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms, keys):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_gravity(dt)
        self.move_and_collide(platforms, dt)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):

            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_pos = (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y - camera_y)
        surface.blit(frame, draw_pos)
```

```python
import os
import sys
import pygame

# -----------------------------
# Configuration
# -----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TITLE = "2D Platformer - Initial Implementation"

GRAVITY = 1800
PLAYER_SPEED = 320
JUMP_VELOCITY = -700
AIR_CONTROL = 0.85
FRICTION = 0.80

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (70, 70, 70)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (90, 90, 90)

ASSET_DIR = "assets"


# -----------------------------
# Utility functions
# -----------------------------
def load_animation_frames(folder, size=(48, 64), fallback_color=(255, 0, 255), count=4):
    """
    Load all image files from a folder as animation frames.
    If the folder doesn't exist or is empty, create fallback surfaces.
    """
    frames = []
    if os.path.isdir(folder):
        files = sorted([
            f for f in os.listdir(folder)
            if f.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp"))
        ])
        for file in files:
            path = os.path.join(folder, file)
            image = pygame.image.load(path).convert_alpha()
            image = pygame.transform.scale(image, size)
            frames.append(image)

    if not frames:
        # Fallback frames: colored rectangles with slight variation
        for i in range(count):
            surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
            color = (
                max(0, min(255, fallback_color[0] - i * 10)),
                max(0, min(255, fallback_color[1] + i * 10)),
                max(0, min(255, fallback_color[2] - i * 5)),
            )
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, color, (0, 0, size[0], size[1]), border_radius=8)
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, (20, 20, 20), (8, 8, size[0] - 16, size[1] - 16), 2, border_radius=6)
            frames.append(surf)

    return frames


# -----------------------------
# Camera
# -----------------------------
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Prevent camera from going above the world too much
        if self.offset.x < 0:
            self.offset.x = 0
        if self.offset.y < 0:
            self.offset.y = 0

    def apply_rect(self, rect):
        return rect.move(-self.offset.x, -self.offset.y)


# -----------------------------
# Platform
# -----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, camera.apply_rect(self.rect), border_radius=4)


# -----------------------------
# Player
# -----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.position = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.velocity = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)
        self.size = (48, 64)
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, self.size[0], self.size[1])

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation data
        self.animations = {
            "idle": load_animation_frames(
                os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "idle"),
                size=self.size,
                fallback_color=(255, 220, 80),
                count=4
            ),
            "run": load_animation_frames(
                os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "run"),
                size=self.size,
                fallback_color=(80, 220, 120),
                count=6
            ),
            "jump": load_animation_frames(
                os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, "jump"),
                size=self.size,
                fallback_color=(80, 160, 255),
                count=2
            ),
        }

        self.current_animation = "idle"
        self.current_frame = 0
        self.animation_timer = 0
        self.animation_speed = {
            "idle": 0.18,
            "run": 0.10,
            "jump": 0.15,
        }

    def handle_input(self, dt):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        move = 0

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            speed = PLAYER_SPEED if self.on_ground else PLAYER_SPEED * AIR_CONTROL
            self.velocity.x = move * speed
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.on_ground:
                self.velocity.x *= FRICTION
                if abs(self.velocity.x) < 10:
                    self.velocity.x = 0

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_gravity(self, dt):
        self.velocity.y += GRAVITY * dt
        if self.velocity.y > 1200:
            self.velocity.y = 1200

    def update(self, dt, platforms):
        self.handle_input(dt)
        self.apply_gravity(dt)

        # Horizontal movement
        self.position.x += self.velocity.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.position.x)
        self.resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="x")

        # Vertical movement
        self.position.y += self.velocity.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.position.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        self.resolve_collisions(platforms, axis="y")

        self.update_animation(dt)

    def resolve_collisions(self, platforms, axis):
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if axis == "x":
                    if self.velocity.x > 0:
                        self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                    elif self.velocity.x < 0:
                        self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                    self.position.x = self.rect.x
                    self.velocity.x = 0

                elif axis == "y":
                    if self.velocity.y > 0:
                        self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                        self.on_ground = True
                    elif self.velocity.y < 0:
                        self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                    self.position.y = self.rect.y
                    self.velocity.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        # Select animation state
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.current_animation = "jump"
        elif abs(self.velocity.x) > 20:
            self.current_animation = "run"
        else:
            self.current_animation = "idle"

        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        self.animation_timer += dt

        if self.animation_timer >= self.animation_speed[self.current_animation]:
            self.animation_timer = 0
            self.current_frame = (self.current_frame + 1) % len(frames)

    def get_current_image(self):
        frames = self.animations[self.current_animation]
        image = frames[self.current_frame]
        if not self.facing_right:
            image = pygame.transform.flip(image, True, False)
        return image

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        image = self.get_current_image()
        draw_rect = camera.apply_rect(self.rect)
        surface.blit(image, draw_rect.topleft)

        # Optional debug hitbox
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), draw_rect, 2)


# -----------------------------
# Level
# -----------------------------
def create_level():
    platforms = []

    # Ground
    platforms.append(Platform(-200, 480, 2200, 100))

    # Floating platforms
    platforms.append(Platform(200, 380, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(420, 320, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(650, 260, 140, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(900, 340, 180, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1180, 280, 160, 20))
    platforms.append(Platform(1450, 220, 200, 20))

    # Some vertical variation
    platforms.append(Platform(1700, 380, 180, 20))

    return platforms


# -----------------------------
# Main game loop
# -----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

    player = Player(100, 200)
    platforms = create_level()
    camera = Camera(SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

        # Events
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_w, pygame.K_UP):
                    player.jump()

        # Update
        player.update(dt, platforms)
        camera.follow(player.rect)

        # Draw
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple background details
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (100, 190, 100), (0, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 80, SCREEN_WIDTH, 80))

        for platform in platforms:
            platform.draw(screen, camera)

        player.draw(screen, camera)

        # UI/debug text
        info = [
            f"Pos: ({int(player.position.x)}, {int(player.position.y)})",
            f"Vel: ({int(player.velocity.x)}, {int(player.velocity.y)})",
            f"On Ground: {player.on_ground}",
            f"Animation: {player.current_animation}",
        ]

        for i, line in enumerate(info):
            text = font.render(line, True, (20, 20, 20))
            screen.blit(text, (12, 12 + i * 24))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import os
import sys
import pygame

# -----------------------------
# Config
# -----------------------------
SCREEN_WIDTH = 960
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 540
FPS = 60
TITLE = "2D Platformer - Initial Implementation"

GRAVITY = 1800
PLAYER_ACCEL = 2200
PLAYER_FRICTION = 1800
PLAYER_MAX_SPEED = 320
PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY = -700

BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)
GROUND_COLOR = (80, 180, 90)
PLATFORM_COLOR = (100, 100, 120)

ASSET_DIR = "assets"


# -----------------------------
# Utility
# -----------------------------
def load_image(path, size=None):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        image = pygame.image.load(path).convert_alpha()
        if size:
            image = pygame.transform.scale(image, size)
        return image
    return None


def clamp(value, min_value, max_value):
    return max(min_value, min(value, max_value))


# -----------------------------
# Animation
# -----------------------------
class Animation:
    def __init__(self, frames, frame_duration, loop=True):
        self.frames = frames
        self.frame_duration = frame_duration
        self.loop = loop
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def reset(self):
        self.time = 0.0
        self.index = 0
        self.finished = False

    def update(self, dt):
        if len(self.frames) <= 1 or self.finished:
            return

        self.time += dt
        while self.time >= self.frame_duration:
            self.time -= self.frame_duration
            self.index += 1

            if self.index >= len(self.frames):
                if self.loop:
                    self.index = 0
                else:
                    self.index = len(self.frames) - 1
                    self.finished = True

    def get_frame(self):
        return self.frames[self.index]


# -----------------------------
# World objects
# -----------------------------
class Platform:
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        draw_rect = pygame.Rect(
            self.rect.x - camera_x,
            self.rect.y - camera_y,
            self.rect.width,
            self.rect.height,
        )
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATFORM_COLOR, draw_rect)


class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 48, 64)
        self.pos = pygame.Vector2(x, y)
        self.vel = pygame.Vector2(0, 0)

        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        self.animations = self.load_animations()
        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

    def load_animations(self):
        def fallback_frames(color, count, size=(48, 64)):
            frames = []
            for i in range(count):
                surf = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
                surf.fill(color)
                pygame.draw.rect(surf, (0, 0, 0), surf.get_rect(), 2)
                pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 255, 255), (size[0] // 2, 14), 6)
                pygame.draw.rect(surf, (30, 30, 30), (10 + i % 3, 24, 28, 28))
                frames.append(surf)
            return frames

        idle_frames = []
        run_frames = []
        jump_frames = []

        for i in range(2):
            img = load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, f"idle_{i}.png"), (48, 64))
            idle_frames.append(img if img else None)

        for i in range(4):
            img = load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, f"run_{i}.png"), (48, 64))
            run_frames.append(img if img else None)

        for i in range(1):
            img = load_image(os.path.join(ASSET_DIR, f"jump_{i}.png"), (48, 64))
            jump_frames.append(img if img else None)

        if any(frame is None for frame in idle_frames):
            idle_frames = fallback_frames((240, 200, 80), 2)

        if any(frame is None for frame in run_frames):
            run_frames = fallback_frames((80, 180, 240), 4)

        if any(frame is None for frame in jump_frames):
            jump_frames = fallback_frames((240, 120, 120), 1)

        return {
            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.35, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.10, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.20, loop=False),
        }

    def set_animation(self, name):
        if self.current_animation_name != name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, dt):
        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_a] or keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_d] or keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
            move += 1

        if move != 0:
            self.vel.x += move * PLAYER_ACCEL * dt
            self.facing_right = move > 0
        else:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x += PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

        if (keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_w] or keys[pygame.K_UP]) and self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = PLAYER_JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, dt, platforms):
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt

        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = platform.rect.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = platform.rect.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical movement
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for platform in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = platform.rect.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = platform.rect.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

    def update_animation(self, dt):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.current_animation.update(dt)

    def update(self, dt, platforms):
        self.handle_input(dt)
        self.apply_physics(dt, platforms)
        self.update_animation(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x, camera_y):
        frame = self.current_animation.get_frame()
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_x = self.rect.x - camera_x
        draw_y = self.rect.y - camera_y
        surface.blit(frame, (draw_x, draw_y))

        # Debug hitbox
        # pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), (draw_x, draw_y, self.rect.width, self.rect.height), 2)


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        pygame.init()
        pygame.display.set_caption(TITLE)
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 20)

        self.player = Player(100, 200)
        self.platforms = self.create_level()

        self.camera_x = 0
        self.camera_y = 0

        self.running = True

    def create_level(self):
        return [
            Platform(-400, 500, 2000, 80),  # ground
            Platform(250, 420, 180, 24),
            Platform(520, 350, 180, 24),
            Platform(780, 280, 180, 24),
            Platform(1080, 360, 220, 24),
            Platform(1400, 440, 240, 24),
        ]

    def update_camera(self):
        target_x = self.player.rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        target_y = self.player.rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        # Smooth follow
        self.camera_x += (target_x - self.camera_x) * 0.1
        self.camera_y += (target_y - self.camera_y) * 0.1

        # Prevent camera from going too high above level
        self.camera_y = min(self.camera_y, 200)

    def draw_background(self):
        self.screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple parallax hills
        for i in range(5):
            x = i * 400 - (self.camera_x * 0.3) % 400
            pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (110, 190, 110), (x, 380, 320, 120))
            pygame.draw.ellipse(self.screen, (90, 170, 90), (x + 120, 400, 300, 100))

    def draw(self):
        self.draw_background()

        for platform in self.platforms:
            platform.draw(self.screen, self.camera_x, self.camera_y)

        self.player.draw(self.screen, self.camera_x, self.camera_y)

        debug_text = f"pos=({self.player.rect.x}, {self.player.rect.y}) vel=({self.player.vel.x:.1f}, {self.player.vel.y:.1f}) on_ground={self.player.on_ground}"
        text_surf = self.font.render(debug_text, True, (20, 20, 20))
        self.screen.blit(text_surf, (12, 12))

        controls = "Move: A/D or Arrows | Jump: Space/W/Up"
        controls_surf = self.font.render(controls, True, (20, 20, 20))
        self.screen.blit(controls_surf, (12, 38))

        pygame.display.flip()

    def run(self):
        while self.running:
            dt = self.clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0

            for event in pygame.event.get():
                if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                    self.running = False

            self.player.update(dt, self.platforms)
            self.update_camera()
            self.draw()

        pygame.quit()
        sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    Game().run()
```

```python
class Camera:
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.offset = Vector2(0, 0)
        self.width = width
        self.height = height

    def follow(self, target_rect, world_width, world_height):
        self.offset.x = target_rect.centerx - SCREEN_WIDTH // 2
        self.offset.y = target_rect.centery - SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2

        self.offset.x = clamp(self.offset.x, 0, max(0, world_width - SCREEN_WIDTH))
        self.offset.y = clamp(self.offset.y, 0, max(0, world_height - SCREEN_HEIGHT))

    def apply_rect(self, rect):
        return rect.move(-self.offset.x, -self.offset.y)


# ----------------------------
# Tile map
# ----------------------------
class TileMap:
    def __init__(self, level_map, tile_size):
        self.level_map = level_map
        self.tile_size = tile_size
        self.solid_tiles = []
        self.world_width = len(level_map[0]) * tile_size
        self.world_height = len(level_map) * tile_size
        self._build()

    def _build(self):
        for row_idx, row in enumerate(self.level_map):
            for col_idx, cell in enumerate(row):
                if cell == "#":
                    rect = pygame.Rect(
                        col_idx * self.tile_size,
                        row_idx * self.tile_size,
                        self.tile_size,
                        self.tile_size,
                    )
                    self.solid_tiles.append(rect)

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            screen_rect = camera.apply_rect(tile)
            color = GROUND_COLOR if tile.y >= (len(self.level_map) - 3) * self.tile_size else PLATFORM_COLOR
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, color, screen_rect)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 50, 40), screen_rect, 2)

    def get_nearby_tiles(self, rect):
        nearby = []
        padding = self.tile_size * 2
        query = rect.inflate(padding, padding)
        for tile in self.solid_tiles:
            if tile.colliderect(query):
                nearby.append(tile)
        return nearby

        self.current_animation_name = "idle"
        self.current_animation = self.animations[self.current_animation_name]

    def _make_frame(self, body_color, leg_offset=0, arm_offset=0):
        surf = pygame.Surface((48, 64), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        # Head
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 220, 180), (24, 12), 10)

        # Body
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (16, 22, 16, 20), border_radius=4)

        # Arms
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 220, 180), (10 + arm_offset, 24, 6, 18), border_radius=3)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (255, 220, 180), (32 - arm_offset, 24, 6, 18), border_radius=3)

        # Legs
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 120), (16, 42, 6, 16 + abs(leg_offset)), border_radius=3)
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (40, 40, 120), (26, 42, 6, 16 - abs(leg_offset) // 2), border_radius=3)

        # Feet

        pygame.draw.rect(surf, (20, 20, 20), (24, 54 + abs(leg_offset) // 2, 10, 4), border_radius=2)

        return surf

    def _create_placeholder_animations(self):
        idle_frames = [
            self._make_frame((220, 60, 60), 0, 0),
            self._make_frame((220, 70, 70), 1, 0),
        ]
        run_frames = [
            self._make_frame((60, 180, 255), 0, -2),
            self._make_frame((60, 180, 255), 4, 2),
            self._make_frame((60, 180, 255), 1, -1),
            self._make_frame((60, 180, 255), 5, 1),
        ]

            "idle": Animation(idle_frames, 0.4, loop=True),
            "run": Animation(run_frames, 0.12, loop=True),
            "jump": Animation(jump_frames, 0.1, loop=True),
        }

        if name != self.current_animation_name:
            self.current_animation_name = name
            self.current_animation = self.animations[name]
            self.current_animation.reset()

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        move = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            move -= 1
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            move += 1
        return move

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def update(self, dt, tiles, keys):
        move_dir = self.handle_input(keys)

        # Horizontal acceleration / friction
        if move_dir != 0:
            self.vel.x += move_dir * PLAYER_ACCEL * dt
            self.facing_right = move_dir > 0
        else:
            if self.vel.x > 0:
                self.vel.x -= PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0
            elif self.vel.x < 0:
                self.vel.x += PLAYER_FRICTION * dt
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.vel.x = 0

        self.vel.x = clamp(self.vel.x, -PLAYER_MAX_SPEED, PLAYER_MAX_SPEED)

        # Gravity
        self.vel.y += GRAVITY * dt
        if self.vel.y > 1200:
            self.vel.y = 1200

        # Horizontal movement
        self.pos.x += self.vel.x * dt
        self.rect.x = round(self.pos.x)
        nearby = tiles.get_nearby_tiles(self.rect)
        for tile in nearby:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile):
                if self.vel.x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = tile.left
                elif self.vel.x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = tile.right
                self.pos.x = self.rect.x
                self.vel.x = 0

        # Vertical movement
        self.on_ground = False
        self.pos.y += self.vel.y * dt
        self.rect.y = round(self.pos.y)
        nearby = tiles.get_nearby_tiles(self.rect)
        for tile in nearby:
            if self.rect.colliderect(tile):
                if self.vel.y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = tile.top
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel.y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = tile.bottom
                self.pos.y = self.rect.y
                self.vel.y = 0

        # Animation state
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.set_animation("jump")
        elif abs(self.vel.x) > 20:
            self.set_animation("run")
        else:
            self.set_animation("idle")

        self.current_animation.update(dt)

    def draw(self, surface, camera):
        frame = self.current_animation.get_frame()
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)

        draw_x = self.rect.centerx - frame.get_width() // 2
        draw_y = self.rect.bottom - frame.get_height()
        draw_rect = pygame.Rect(draw_x, draw_y, frame.get_width(), frame.get_height())
        draw_rect = camera.apply_rect(draw_rect)

        surface.blit(frame, draw_rect.topleft)

        if DEBUG:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 0, 0), camera.apply_rect(self.rect), 2)


# ----------------------------
# Game
# ----------------------------
def draw_background(surface, camera, world_width, world_height):
    surface.fill(BG_COLOR)

    # Simple parallax hills
    hill_color_1 = (110, 190, 110)
    hill_color_2 = (90, 170, 90)

    for i in range(6):
        x = i * 300 - (camera.offset.x * 0.3) % 300
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, hill_color_1, (x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 180, 360, 140))

    for i in range(5):
        x = i * 380 - (camera.offset.x * 0.5) % 380
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, hill_color_2, (x, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 130, 420, 120))


def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Initial 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    tile_map = TileMap(LEVEL_MAP, TILE_SIZE)
    player = Player(120, 200)
    camera = Camera(tile_map.world_width, tile_map.world_height)

    running = True
    while running:
        dt = clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
        dt = min(dt, 1 / 30)  # avoid huge step after lag spike

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(dt, tile_map, keys)
        camera.follow(player.rect, tile_map.world_width, tile_map.world_height)

        draw_background(screen, camera, tile_map.world_width, tile_map.world_height)
        tile_map.draw(screen, camera)
        player.draw(screen, camera)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import pygame
import sys

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 960, 540
FPS = 60
GRAVITY = 0.6
MOVE_SPEED = 5
JUMP_VELOCITY = -13
BG_COLOR = (135, 206, 235)

# ----------------------------
# Platform class
# ----------------------------
class Platform(pygame.Rect):
    def __init__(self, x, y, w, h, color=(80, 60, 40)):
        super().__init__(x, y, w, h)
        self.color = color

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, self.color, (self.x - camera_x, self.y, self.w, self.h))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 120, 40), (self.x - camera_x, self.y, self.w, 8))


# ----------------------------
# Player class
# ----------------------------
class Player:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 40, 56)
        self.vel_x = 0
        self.vel_y = 0
        self.on_ground = False
        self.facing_right = True

        # Animation
        self.animations = {
            "idle": self.make_frames((255, 220, 50), 2),
            "run": self.make_frames((50, 220, 255), 4),
            "jump": self.make_frames((255, 100, 100), 1),
        }
        self.state = "idle"
        self.frame_index = 0
        self.anim_timer = 0

    def make_frames(self, body_color, count):
        frames = []
        for i in range(count):
            surf = pygame.Surface((40, 56), pygame.SRCALPHA)

            # Head
            pygame.draw.circle(surf, (255, 224, 189), (20, 12), 10)

            # Body with slight animation variation
            body_offset = (i % 2) * 2
            pygame.draw.rect(surf, body_color, (12, 22, 16, 18))

            # Arms
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (12, 26), (6 + body_offset, 34), 3)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (30, 30, 30), (28, 26), (34 - body_offset, 34), 3)

            # Legs
            leg_offset = (i % 2) * 4
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (20, 20, 20), (16, 40), (12 + leg_offset, 54), 4)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, (20, 20, 20), (24, 40), (28 - leg_offset, 54), 4)

            frames.append(surf)
        return frames

    def handle_input(self, keys):
        self.vel_x = 0
        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]:
            self.vel_x = -MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = False
        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT] or keys[pygame.K_d]:
            self.vel_x = MOVE_SPEED
            self.facing_right = True

    def jump(self):
        if self.on_ground:
            self.vel_y = JUMP_VELOCITY
            self.on_ground = False

    def apply_physics(self, platforms):
        # Horizontal movement
        self.rect.x += self.vel_x
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p):
                if self.vel_x > 0:
                    self.rect.right = p.left
                elif self.vel_x < 0:
                    self.rect.left = p.right

        # Gravity
        self.vel_y += GRAVITY
        if self.vel_y > 15:
            self.vel_y = 15

        # Vertical movement
        self.rect.y += int(self.vel_y)
        self.on_ground = False
        for p in platforms:
            if self.rect.colliderect(p):
                if self.vel_y > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = p.top
                    self.vel_y = 0
                    self.on_ground = True
                elif self.vel_y < 0:
                    self.rect.top = p.bottom
                    self.vel_y = 0

    def update_animation(self):
        if not self.on_ground:
            self.state = "jump"
        elif self.vel_x != 0:
            self.state = "run"
        else:
            self.state = "idle"

        self.anim_timer += 1
        frames = self.animations[self.state]

        if self.anim_timer >= 10:
            self.anim_timer = 0
            self.frame_index = (self.frame_index + 1) % len(frames)

        if self.frame_index >= len(frames):
            self.frame_index = 0

    def update(self, keys, platforms):
        self.handle_input(keys)
        self.apply_physics(platforms)
        self.update_animation()

    def draw(self, surface, camera_x=0):
        frame = self.animations[self.state][self.frame_index]
        if not self.facing_right:
            frame = pygame.transform.flip(frame, True, False)
        surface.blit(frame, (self.rect.x - camera_x, self.rect.y))


# ----------------------------
# Main game
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Minimal 2D Platformer")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 28)

    player = Player(100, 100)

    platforms = [
        Platform(-200, 500, 1600, 60),
        Platform(220, 420, 140, 20),
        Platform(430, 350, 140, 20),
        Platform(650, 280, 140, 20),
        Platform(900, 430, 180, 20),
        Platform(1180, 360, 180, 20),
    ]

    running = True
    while running:
        clock.tick(FPS)

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_UP, pygame.K_w):
                    player.jump()

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        player.update(keys, platforms)

        # Simple side-scrolling camera
        camera_x = max(0, player.rect.centerx - WIDTH // 2)

        # Draw background
        screen.fill(BG_COLOR)

        # Simple clouds
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (100 - camera_x * 0.2, 70, 120, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (350 - camera_x * 0.15, 110, 150, 45))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (255, 255, 255), (700 - camera_x * 0.1, 80, 130, 38))

        # Draw platforms
        for p in platforms:
            p.draw(screen, camera_x)

        # Draw player
        player.draw(screen, camera_x)

        # UI
        text = font.render("Arrows/A,D to move | Space/W/Up to jump", True, (20, 20, 20))
        screen.blit(text, (20, 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
