```python
    if req.from_account == req.to_account:

    if accounts[req.from_account] < req.amount:

        "from_account": req.from_account,
        "to_account": req.to_account,
        "amount": str(req.amount),
        "status": "completed",
    }
    transactions.append(tx)
    return tx


@app.get("/transactions")
```

```python
import asyncio

app = FastAPI(title="Mock Payment Service")

class PaymentStatus(str, Enum):
    pending = "pending"
    processing = "processing"
    succeeded = "succeeded"
    failed = "failed"

class CreatePaymentRequest(BaseModel):
    amount: Decimal = Field(..., gt=0, description="Payment amount")
    currency: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=3, description="ISO currency code")
    reference: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)

    amount: Decimal
    currency: str
    reference: str
    status: PaymentStatus

    return {"status": "ok"}

async def create_payment(req: CreatePaymentRequest):
    payment_id = str(uuid4())
    payment = PaymentResponse(
        payment_id=payment_id,
        amount=req.amount,
        currency=req.currency.upper(),
        reference=req.reference,
        status=PaymentStatus.pending,
    )
    payments[payment_id] = payment

    asyncio.create_task(process_payment(payment_id))
    return payment

@app.get("/payments/{payment_id}", response_model=PaymentResponse)
def get_payment(payment_id: str):
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Payment not found")
    return payment

async def process_payment(payment_id: str):
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    payment = payments.get(payment_id)
    if not payment:
        return

    payment.status = PaymentStatus.processing
    payments[payment_id] = payment

    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    payment.status = PaymentStatus.succeeded
    payments[payment_id] = payment
```

```python
    @field_validator("amount")
    @classmethod
    def validate_amount_precision(cls, v: Decimal):
        if v.as_tuple().exponent < -2:
            raise ValueError("amount cannot have more than 2 decimal places")
        return v

class PaymentRecord(BaseModel):
    payment_id: str
    customer_id: str
    amount: Decimal
    currency: Currency
    reference: str
    status: PaymentStatus
    created_at: datetime

    status = PaymentStatus.APPROVED if req.amount <= Decimal("1000.00") else PaymentStatus.PENDING

    if not record:

@app.post("/payments/{payment_id}/review", response_model=PaymentRecord)
def review_payment(payment_id: str, approve: bool):
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.DTOs;
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Interfaces;
using EnterpriseBackend.Domain.Entities;
using EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Application.Services;

public class CustomerService : ICustomerService
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;

    public CustomerService(AppDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyCollection<CustomerDto>> GetAllAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Customers
            .AsNoTracking()
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .Select(x => new CustomerDto(
                x.Id,
                x.ExternalId,
                x.Name,
                x.Email,
                x.CreatedUtc))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<CustomerDto?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Customers
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(x => x.Id == id)
            .Select(x => new CustomerDto(
                x.Id,
                x.ExternalId,
                x.Name,
                x.Email,
                x.CreatedUtc))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<CustomerDto> CreateAsync(CreateCustomerRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var entity = new Customer
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            ExternalId = request.ExternalId,
            Name = request.Name,
            Email = request.Email,
            CreatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _dbContext.Customers.Add(entity);
        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new CustomerDto(
            entity.Id,
            entity.ExternalId,
            entity.Name,
            entity.Email,
            entity.CreatedUtc);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<Customer> Customers => Set<Customer>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity<Customer>(entity =>
        {
            entity.ToTable("Customers");
            entity.HasKey(x => x.Id);

            entity.Property(x => x.ExternalId)
                .HasMaxLength(100)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.Name)
                .HasMaxLength(200)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.Email)
                .HasMaxLength(320)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.Property(x => x.CreatedUtc)
                .IsRequired();

            entity.HasIndex(x => x.ExternalId)
                .IsUnique();
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace EnterpriseBackend.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class CustomersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;

    public CustomersController(ICustomerService customerService)
    {
        _customerService = customerService;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<ActionResult<IReadOnlyCollection<CustomerDto>>> GetAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var customers = await _customerService.GetAllAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Ok(customers);
    }

    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<CustomerDto>> GetById(Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var customer = await _customerService.GetByIdAsync(id, cancellationToken);

        if (customer is null)
            return NotFound();

        return Ok(customer);
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "RequireWriterRole")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<CustomerDto>> Create(
        [FromBody] CreateCustomerRequest request,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var created = await _customerService.CreateAsync(request, cancellationToken);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = created.Id }, created);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Azure.Identity;
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Interfaces;
using EnterpriseBackend.Application.Services;
using EnterpriseBackend.Infrastructure.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Identity.Web;
using Serilog;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .ReadFrom.Configuration(builder.Configuration)
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .WriteTo.Console()
    .CreateLogger();

builder.Host.UseSerilog();

// Azure Key Vault integration
var keyVaultUrl = builder.Configuration["KeyVault:VaultUrl"];
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyVaultUrl))
{
    builder.Configuration.AddAzureKeyVault(
        new Uri(keyVaultUrl),
        new DefaultAzureCredential());
}

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

builder.Services.AddScoped<ICustomerService, CustomerService>();

builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddMicrosoftIdentityWebApi(builder.Configuration.GetSection("AzureAd"));

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("RequireWriterRole", policy =>
        policy.RequireRole("Api.Writer", "Api.Admin"));
});

builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
    .AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>("database");

builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware pipeline
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapHealthChecks("/health");

app.Run();
```

# 10. Enterprise security recommendations for this environment

For a real enterprise deployment, I strongly recommend these next steps:

## Authentication and authorization
- Use **Microsoft Entra ID**
- Prefer **app roles** or **groups**
- Validate `aud`, `iss`, and tenant restrictions
- Separate:
  - user-facing delegated access
  - service-to-service client credential flows

## Secrets
- Move connection strings and secrets to **Azure Key Vault**
- Use **Managed Identity** instead of client secrets where possible

## Network security
- Restrict Azure SQL firewall
- Use **private endpoints**
- Use **VNet integration**
- Disable public access where possible

## Logging and monitoring
- Send telemetry to **Application Insights**
- Add correlation IDs
- Log user/object IDs, not sensitive payloads
- Add alerts for:
  - 5xx spikes
  - auth failures
  - DB connectivity failures

## Data protection
- Add input validation
- Add PII handling rules
- Add audit logging for create/update/delete actions
- Consider encryption requirements and retention policies

# 12. Important improvement for large enterprise architecture

Your initial implementation should eventually separate concerns more cleanly.

Right now, `Application` references `Infrastructure`, which is okay for a quick starter, but for a more mature architecture you’d usually do:

- `Domain`
- `Application`
- `Infrastructure`
- `Api`

Where:
- `Application` defines interfaces
- `Infrastructure` implements repositories/data access
- `Api` depends on `Application` and `Infrastructure`
- `Application` should not depend on `Infrastructure`

# 4. Main application

## `Program.cs`

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using EnterpriseBackend.Data;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Configuration
var configuration = builder.Configuration;

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

// Database
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Azure AD JWT Authentication
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.Authority = $"{configuration["AzureAd:Instance"]}{configuration["AzureAd:TenantId"]}/v2.0";
        options.Audience = configuration["AzureAd:ClientId"];
        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapHealthChecks("/health");
app.MapControllers();

// Ensure database exists for demo purposes
using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
    db.Database.EnsureCreated();

    if (!db.Customers.Any())
    {
        db.Customers.AddRange(
            new Customer { Name = "Contoso Ltd", Email = "contact@contoso.com" },
            new Customer { Name = "Fabrikam Inc", Email = "hello@fabrikam.com" }
        );
        db.SaveChanges();
    }
}

app.Run();
```

# 6. Controller

## `Controllers/CustomersController.cs`

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using EnterpriseBackend.Data;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class CustomersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;

    public CustomersController(AppDbContext db)
    {
        _db = db;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get()
    {
        var customers = await _db.Customers
            .Select(c => new
            {
                c.Id,
                c.Name,
                c.Email
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(customers);
    }
}
```

# 3. `Controllers/SecureController.cs`

Create this file:

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/[controller]")]
    public class SecureController : ControllerBase
    {
        [HttpGet("public")]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public IActionResult Public()
        {
            return Ok(new
            {
                message = "This is a public endpoint."
            });
        }

        [HttpGet("me")]
        [Authorize]
        public IActionResult Me()
        {
            var user = User.Identity?.Name;
            var claims = User.Claims.Select(c => new
            {
                c.Type,
                c.Value
            });

            return Ok(new
            {
                message = "Authenticated request successful.",
                user,
                claims
            });
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Configuration
var configuration = builder.Configuration;

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITimeService, TimeService>();

// Azure AD / Entra ID JWT Authentication
// Expected config:
// Authentication:Authority = https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0
// Authentication:Audience = api://your-api-app-id
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.Authority = configuration["Authentication:Authority"];
        options.Audience = configuration["Authentication:Audience"];

        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

var app = builder.Build();

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapHealthChecks("/health");
app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
```

# 10. Enterprise Azure setup

## A. Create an App Registration for the API

In **Microsoft Entra ID**:

- Create **App registration**
- Save:
  - **Application (client) ID**
  - **Directory (tenant) ID**
- Expose an API:
  - set Application ID URI, e.g.:
    ```text
    api://YOUR-CLIENT-ID
    ```
- Add a scope, e.g.:
  ```text
  access_as_user
  ```

Then match these in `appsettings.json`.

---

## B. Create Azure Key Vault

Store secrets there if needed, such as:

- database connection strings
- downstream API secrets
- certificates

Example secret names:

- `ConnectionStrings--MainDb`
- `SomeApi--ClientSecret`

ASP.NET Core maps `--` to `:`.

---

## C. Enable managed identity

If deploying to **Azure App Service**:

- enable **System Assigned Managed Identity**
- grant it **Key Vault Secrets User** or equivalent access

Then `DefaultAzureCredential()` will work without hardcoded credentials.

---

## D. Application Insights

Create an **Application Insights** resource and put the connection string in:

- App Service application settings, or
- `appsettings.json` for testing only

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class CustomersController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ICustomerService _customerService;
    private readonly ILogger<CustomersController> _logger;

    public CustomersController(ICustomerService customerService, ILogger<CustomersController> logger)
    {
        _customerService = customerService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    public IActionResult GetById(string id)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Fetching customer with id {CustomerId}", id);

        var customer = _customerService.GetCustomerById(id);

        if (customer == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Customer with id {CustomerId} not found", id);
            return NotFound(new { message = "Customer not found" });
        }

        return Ok(customer);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using EnterpriseBackend.Models;
using EnterpriseBackend.Services;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class StatusController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITimeService _timeService;
    private readonly ILogger<StatusController> _logger;

    public StatusController(ITimeService timeService, ILogger<StatusController> logger)
    {
        _timeService = timeService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet("public")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public ActionResult<StatusResponse> GetPublicStatus()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Public status endpoint called");

        return Ok(new StatusResponse
        {
            Service = "EnterpriseBackend",
            Environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") ?? "Production",
            ServerTimeUtc = _timeService.GetUtcNow(),
            Authenticated = false,
            Message = "Service is running"
        });
    }

    [HttpGet("secure")]
    [Authorize]
    public ActionResult<StatusResponse> GetSecureStatus()
    {
        var userName = User.Identity?.Name ?? "unknown";
        _logger.LogInformation("Secure status endpoint called by {User}", userName);

        return Ok(new StatusResponse
        {
            Service = "EnterpriseBackend",
            Environment = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") ?? "Production",
            ServerTimeUtc = _timeService.GetUtcNow(),
            Authenticated = true,
            Message = $"Authenticated request from {userName}"
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

// Configuration
var configuration = builder.Configuration;

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks();

// Azure AD / Microsoft Entra JWT auth
builder.Services
    .AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        var tenantId = configuration["AzureAd:TenantId"];
        var audience = configuration["AzureAd:Audience"];

        options.Authority = $"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0";
        options.Audience = audience;

        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapHealthChecks("/health");
app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
```

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Data;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Logging
builder.Logging.ClearProviders();
builder.Logging.AddConsole();

var configuration = builder.Configuration;

// Services
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
    .AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>("database");

// SQL Server
builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseSqlServer(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Azure AD / Entra ID JWT Authentication
var azureAdInstance = configuration["AzureAd:Instance"];
var tenantId = configuration["AzureAd:TenantId"];
var clientId = configuration["AzureAd:ClientId"];

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(azureAdInstance) &&
    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tenantId) &&
    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientId))
{

        {
            options.Authority = $"{azureAdInstance}{tenantId}/v2.0";
            options.Audience = clientId;
        });

    builder.Services.AddAuthorization();
}

var app = builder.Build();

// Middleware
app.UseHttpsRedirection();

if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clientId))
{
    app.UseAuthentication();
    app.UseAuthorization();
}

app.MapControllers();
app.MapHealthChecks("/health");

app.Run();
```

## `Controllers/StatusController.cs`

```csharp
using EnterpriseBackend.Data;
using EnterpriseBackend.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace EnterpriseBackend.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class StatusController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<StatusController> _logger;

    public StatusController(AppDbContext db, ILogger<StatusController> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Status endpoint called");

        var records = await _db.StatusRecords
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.CreatedUtc)
            .Take(10)
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(records);
    }

    [Authorize]
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Post([FromBody] StatusRecord request)
    {
        var record = new StatusRecord
        {
            ServiceName = request.ServiceName,
            Status = request.Status,
            CreatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.StatusRecords.Add(record);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = record.Id }, record);
    }
}
```

## Go example

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

type response struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Time    string `json:"time"`
	PID     int    `json:"pid"`
}

func main() {
	// Use all available CPU cores
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(runtime.NumCPU())

	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	mux.HandleFunc("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
			"status": "ok",
		})
	})

	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		resp := response{
			Message: "hello",
			Time:    time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
			PID:     os.Getpid(),
		}

		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "encoding error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:              ":8080",
		Handler:           loggingMiddleware(recoverMiddleware(mux)),
		ReadTimeout:       5 * time.Second,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 2 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout:      10 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:       120 * time.Second,
		MaxHeaderBytes:    1 << 20, // 1 MB
		BaseContext: func(l net.Listener) context.Context {
			return context.Background()
		},
	}

	// Start server
	go func() {
		log.Printf("server starting on %s with %d CPUs", server.Addr, runtime.NumCPU())
		if err := server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			log.Fatalf("server failed: %v", err)
		}
	}()

	// Graceful shutdown
	stop := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(stop, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-stop

	log.Println("shutdown signal received")

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
		log.Printf("graceful shutdown failed: %v", err)
		if err := server.Close(); err != nil {
			log.Printf("forced close failed: %v", err)
		}
	}

	log.Println("server stopped")
}

func loggingMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		start := time.Now()
		rw := &statusWriter{ResponseWriter: w, status: http.StatusOK}
		next.ServeHTTP(rw, r)
		log.Printf(
			`method=%s path=%s status=%d remote=%s ua=%q duration_ms=%s content_length=%d`,
			r.Method,
			r.URL.Path,
			rw.status,
			r.RemoteAddr,
			r.UserAgent(),
			strconv.FormatInt(time.Since(start).Milliseconds(), 10),
			r.ContentLength,
		)
	})
}

func recoverMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		defer func() {
			if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
				http.Error(w, "internal server error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			}
		}()
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

type statusWriter struct {
	http.ResponseWriter
	status int
}

func (w *statusWriter) WriteHeader(code int) {
	w.status = code
	w.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(code)
}
```

```go
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("OK\n"))
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:              ":8080",
		Handler:           mux,
		ReadTimeout:       5 * time.Second,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 2 * time.Second,
		WriteTimeout:      5 * time.Second,
		IdleTimeout:       30 * time.Second,
		MaxHeaderBytes:    1 << 20, // 1 MB
	}

	// Reuse port efficiently
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", server.Addr)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("listen error: %v", err)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Listening on http://0.0.0.0%s\n", server.Addr)
	log.Fatal(server.Serve(ln))
}
```

  - enabling graceful shutdown
  - adding request logging/metrics
